006package gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item;
007
008import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.DynamicContext;
009import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.atomic.IAnyAtomicItem;
010import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IArrayItem;
011import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.metapath.item.function.IMapItem;
012import gov.nist.secauto.metaschema.core.util.ObjectUtils;
013
014import java.util.LinkedList;
015import java.util.List;
016import java.util.function.Predicate;
017import java.util.stream.Stream;
018
019import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.NonNull;
020import edu.umd.cs.findbugs.annotations.Nullable;
021
022/**
023 * A data value that can be a value in a Metapath array or map.
024 */
025public interface ICollectionValue {
026  /**
027   * Get the collection value as a sequence.
028   * <p>
029   * If the value is already a sequence, the value is returned as a sequence.
030   * Otherwise, if the value is an item, a new sequence will be created containing
031   * only that item.
032   *
033   * @return the resulting sequence
034   */
035  @NonNull
036  default ISequence<?> toSequence() {
037    return this instanceof ISequence
038        // return the sequence
039        ? (ISequence<?>) this
040        // return the item as a new sequence
041        : ISequence.of((IItem) this);
042  }
043
044  /**
045   * Get the collection value as a sequence.
046   * <p>
047   * If the value is already a sequence, the value is returned as a sequence.
048   * Otherwise, if the value is an item, what is returned depends on the item
049   * type:
050   * <ul>
051   * <li>{@link IArrayItem} or {@link IMapItem}: the contents of the returned
052   * sequence are the items of the array or map. Any member values that are a
053   * sequence are flattened.
054   * <li>Any other item: A singleton sequence is returned containing the item.
055   * </ul>
056   *
057   * @return the resulting sequence
058   */
059  @NonNull
060  ISequence<?> contentsAsSequence();
061
062  /**
063   * Get the stream of items for the collection value.
064   * <p>
065   * If the collection value is a sequence, then the items in the collection are
066   * returned.
067   *
068   * @param value
069   *          the collection value
070   * @return the sequence of related items
071   */
072  @NonNull
073  static Stream<? extends IItem> normalizeAsItems(@NonNull ICollectionValue value) {
074    return value instanceof IItem
075        ? ObjectUtils.notNull(Stream.of((IItem) value))
076        : value.toSequence().stream();
077  }
078
079  /**
080   * Produce a stream of atomic items based on the atomic value of these items.
081   * <p>
082   * Supports <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-31/#id-atomization">item
083   * atomization</a>.
084   *
085   * @return a stream of atomized atomic items.
086   */
087  @NonNull
088  Stream<IAnyAtomicItem> atomize();
089
090  /**
091   * Get the stream of items for the collection value.
092   * <p>
093   * If the collection value contains items, then these items are returned.
094   *
095   * @return a stream of related items
096   */
097  @NonNull
098  Stream<? extends IItem> flatten();
099
100  /**
101   * Determine if this and the other value are deeply equal.
102   * <p>
103   * Item equality is defined by the
104   * <a href="https://www.w3.org/TR/xpath-functions-31/#func-deep-equal">XPath 3.1
105   * fn:deep-equal</a> specification.
106   *
107   * @param other
108   *          the other value to compare to this value to
109   * @param dynamicContext
110   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
111   *          timezone
112   * @return the {@code true} if the two values are equal, or {@code false}
113   *         otherwise
114   */
115  boolean deepEquals(@Nullable ICollectionValue other, @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext);
116
117  /**
118   * Get a representation of the value based on its type signature.
119   *
120   * @return the signature
121   */
122  @NonNull
123  String toSignature();
124
125  /**
126   * Provides a {@link Predicate} which filters items in a stream returning
127   * distinct values based on
128   * {@link #deepEquals(ICollectionValue, DynamicContext)}.
129   *
130   * @param dynamicContext
131   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
132   *          timezone
133   * @return the predicate
134   */
135  static Predicate<? super ICollectionValue> distinctByDeepEquals(@NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
136    return distinctByDeepEquals(ICollectionValue.class, dynamicContext);
137  }
138
139  /**
140   * Provides a {@link Predicate} which filters items in a stream returning
141   * distinct values based on
142   * {@link #deepEquals(ICollectionValue, DynamicContext)}.
143   *
144   * @param <T>
145   *          the Java type of the values filtered
146   * @param clazz
147   *          the Java class for the type handled by the predicate
148   * @param dynamicContext
149   *          used to provide evaluation information, including the implicit
150   *          timezone
151   * @return the predicate
152   */
153  static <T extends ICollectionValue> Predicate<? super T> distinctByDeepEquals(
154      @NonNull Class<T> clazz,
155      @NonNull DynamicContext dynamicContext) {
156    List<T> seen = new LinkedList<>();
157    return item -> !seen.stream().anyMatch(other -> item.deepEquals(other, dynamicContext))
158        && seen.add(item); // true
159  }
160}
